seo.title: Technical notes | OpenMixer
seo.description: How the parts of OpenMixer were measured and decided: plugin qualification, the plugin host, Zynthian on a Raspberry Pi 5 and the host core, one note each.

hero.title: How it was measured, and why it is built this way.
hero.lede: Each note explains one part: the method, the numbers, the versions and the date of the measurement. The reference of each project is on its own page; these notes are the reasoning behind it.
